top_signals.title: UK cyber agency seeing ‘marked rise’ in AI-driven attacks
top_signals.summary: Britain’s National Cyber Security Centre said it has observed “a marked rise” since September in cyberattacks assisted by artificial intelligence and warned the technology was increasing attackers’ speed, scale and persistence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
top_signals.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.
